subject: sociology

items.q: Is sociological research just personal opinion?
items.correct: No — it uses systematic methods and evidence.
items.why: Sociologists use surveys, interviews and observation, judged on validity, reliability and representativeness.

items.q: Why do sociologists worry about a sample being representative?
items.correct: So findings can be generalised to the wider population.
items.random_wrong: A sample must include the whole population.
items.why: An unrepresentative sample produces biased conclusions that can't be generalised.

specSource: Cambridge IGCSE Sociology (0495) syllabus; Theory & Methods
